summary:
Submitted 12 binary STL solids and keyless.json: a stem, spring axial clutch, winding pinion, face/spur winding transfer, barrel ratchet, spring click, setting transfer, and five fixed guides/bearings. Nominal winding ratio is 4.95:1; the 36-tooth clutch limits take-up to 10 degrees. Pulling disengages winding before setting engages.

AT-0 passes the local checks: every part loads as one watertight positive-volume solid; all manifest references are valid; rest intersections stay within 0.0002 mm^3; non-stem parts fit the case; all declared free/spring mobiles pass the 0.3 mm retention probes. There are 80,880 triangles total, at most 28,496 per file. Stem material reaches 0.822 mm beyond the case radius.

Full AT-1 through AT-6 sequences were not executed in the acceptance rig, which was not supplied, so those claims are not_tested. A local directed, minimal-displacement contact solver using the specified overlap tolerance predicts 72.34 degrees of arbor winding per crown turn (4.98:1), about 3 degrees of initial click run-back, approximately 47.93 hours reserve, and 16.4 degrees of minute-wheel movement each way per 90-degree setting turn. Isolated backward release needs less than 0.019 mm clutch travel. Five-stop test turns show no simultaneous train drive; aligned pull was checked every 0.03 mm. Short-turn predictions are 4.45 degrees winding for 24 degrees at position 1, 5.63 after backward release, 3.84 after run-direction take-up, and 17.78 after return. These local checks do not reproduce the full coupled friction solver, rocking sequence, or 40-step tapped hold. Analytic friction checks give a worst clutch release ramp of 28.88 degrees and click ramp of 20.18 degrees, below a conservative two-interface release limit of 35.96 degrees for mu=0.51.

Difficulties, in order: direct skew-axis engagement required an intermediate wheel; repeated-sector Boolean crowns produced dense meshes and seam fragments; unavailable optional NetworkX helpers required local mesh orientation code; clutch STL seams required a continuous periodic surface and vertex welding; washer overlaps were cleared; shallower clutch teeth exposed a hub overlap, which was removed. A later NumPy 2D cross-product inspection helper was replaced locally. No packages were installed.

Ambiguity: on_stem does not explicitly define the axial reference of its slide coordinate. Physical stem-collar contact establishes axial clutch following.

Outside access: none
